subject: Next steps: stakeholder owners & NDA / contract sequencing
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@healthsync.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: stakeholder owners & NDA / contract sequencing

Hi Liam — thanks for the call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Outcome: HealthSync is interested in a 30-day pilot focused on clinical note summarization (5000 daily active notes).
- Key decision criteria you mentioned: throughput (p99 latency), PII handling & audit logs, and predictable unit cost.
- Proposed pilot sequencing: 1) Quick NDA to share sample dataset + SSO test account, 2) Security questionnaire & short architecture review with Eva, 3) Pilot MSA + DPA redline cycle.

As discussed, could you confirm the following owners so we can route docs correctly?
- Economic buyer / contract sign: you (Liam) — please confirm
- Security / infra technical reviewer: Eva Martinez (cc'd)
- Procurement / legal reviewer: procurement@healthsync.com (per your mention)

If that matches, we'll: share a short mutual NDA (attached), put together a 2-week pilot plan and estimate legal turn times for each doc. My asks: 
1) Confirm owners above and whether NDA needs any specific legal language (data residency, vendor clauses).
2) If procurement prefers DocuSign or internal contract portal, let us know.

Attaching a one-page recap and our one-way NDA draft to speed things up. Proposed internal owner at Redwood for routing: Ben (contracts lead) and Marissa (security/compliance).

Next available dates for the security call: Thursday 8/13 or Monday 8/17 — EVA, which works?

Thanks,

— Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-NDA-v1.pdf (application/pdf), Postcall-recap-HealthSync-20260812.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@healthsync.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Eva Martinez <eva.martinez@healthsync.com>, procurement@healthsync.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: stakeholder owners & NDA / contract sequencing

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the tidy recap. Confirmations below: 

- Economic buyer / signer: yes, that's me.
- Security reviewer: Eva (copied) — she'll take the technical review.
- Procurement: procurement@healthsync.com is correct; they prefer DocuSign for signature-ready docs.

A couple of notes on terms: 
- We will need a short DPA with data processing clauses (standard EU addendum for any cross-border).
- For the NDA, please avoid unilateral non-compete language — our legal team flags that.

Eva — can you do a short sync on Thurs 8/13 at 10am PT to go over infra/access? If that works, we can get the sample dataset approved.

Liam
VP Product, HealthSync
liam.oconnor@healthsync.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: stakeholder owners & NDA / contract sequencing

Jasmine — thanks for looping us. Suggested internal routing & estimated turn times below (we should confirm with legal ops but this is our typical cadence):

1) NDA (one-way / mutual depending on their ask) — owner: Ben Carter (Contracts). EST turnaround: 1 business day to send editable draft, 1-3 business days for a single redline pass.
2) Security questionnaire + infra sync — owner: Marissa (Security/Compliance). EST: 2 business days to review questionnaire, immediate follow-up call.
3) Pilot MSA + DPA — owner: Contracts + Legal Ops (Karthik support on commercial). EST: 5-10 business days for initial redline cycle; additional 3-7 days per legal counter-party redline depending on procurement bandwidth.

Routing recommendation: Send NDA first to unblock sample data exchange and SSO. After we receive signed NDA, Marissa should get the sample and do an initial compliance sign-off. If the security review is straightforward, we park MSA discussions until pilot acceptance metrics are agreed. This reduces legal churn.

I'll prep the NDA draft and a one-pager with expected redline fields we typically see (liability caps, data handling, termination). Jasmine — I'll upload the NDA to the shared Drive and start the DocuSign envelope if they prefer that flow.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Contracts, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: none

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@healthsync.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Eva Martinez <eva.martinez@healthsync.com>, procurement@healthsync.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: stakeholder owners & NDA / contract sequencing

Hi all — thanks for the confirmations. Per Ben's note, attaching the same NDA as an editable Word + a short checklist so procurement can see the minimal items we'd like to keep out of scope for the pilot (e.g., production SLAs, long-term indemnities).

Action items I will own:
- Ben: please upload the editable NDA to the Drive and create the DocuSign envelope (if HealthSync confirms).
- Marissa: will take the infra questionnaire after NDA is signed.
- Karthik: I'll loop you when we start commercial redlines.
- Liam/Eva/procurement: please sign or initial NDA on DocuSign (or return a redline) by Tue 8/18 if possible so we can start the pilot week of 8/24.

Proposed sequencing (short):
1) NDA signed -> share sample dataset + SSO test account (2 business days)
2) Security call -> security sign-off (3-5 business days)
3) Pilot kickoff + monitoring dashboard access
4) MSA/DPA redline while pilot runs (parallel)

Thanks — attaching: Redwood-NDA-v1.pdf and Postcall-recap-HealthSync-20260812.docx to this thread for reference.

— Jasmine

From: Eva Martinez <eva.martinez@healthsync.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@healthsync.com>
Cc: procurement@healthsync.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: stakeholder owners & NDA / contract sequencing

Thanks everyone — 10am PT on Thu 8/13 worked well; quick notes from my side: 

- Infra review: OK to receive a small anonymized sample (up to 500 notes) over SFTP or secure SharePoint. No PHI in the sample; if PHI is present we need a DPA in place first.
- Access: service account + IP allowlist preferred, temporary credentials for pilot.
- Security questionnaire: I'll fill out the security questionnaire by Tue 8/17 after reviewing the NDA draft. Expect one minor ask around encryption-in-transit confirmation.

Procurement: we'll aim to turn the NDA in 1-2 business days once Ben sends the DocuSign envelope. Liam — I'll coordinate with procurement for the signature flow.

Eva Martinez
Director, Security Engineering
HealthSync
